source.dataset_name: DOB NOW: Build - Job Application Filings

definitions.cohort: Initial (-I) DOB NOW: Build filings, excluding job type 'No Work', whose first_permit_date falls in the window.
definitions.days: Calendar days between the date parts of the two timestamps.
definitions.review: filing_date -> approved_date (plan approval). Professional Certification jobs sometimes have no approved_date, so they are under-represented in review and post_approval.
definitions.review_route: filing_review_type: Standard Plan Examination or Professional Certification.
definitions.p90: 90th percentile (linear interpolation): 9 in 10 jobs took this long or less.
definitions.low_n: Fewer than 30 jobs in the group; treat as unreliable.
definitions.still_waiting: Initial filings filed in the window, excluding 'No Work', with no first_permit_date as of the download.

drop rows missing a filing date
